title: 28,800 Bath Toys Fell Into the Sea and Drifted for Decades

scenes.text: In 1992, a storm dumped 28,800 bath toys into the ocean.
Yellow ducks, blue turtles, and green frogs.
They left Hong Kong and were lost in the North Pacific.
Within a year, hundreds washed up near Sitka, Alaska.
An oceanographer used them to track the ocean's currents.
Decades later, a few were still believed to be drifting.

description:
In 1992, a storm dumped 28,800 bath toys into the ocean.
They washed up in Alaska and helped scientists track ocean currents.
What would you do if you found one?
first_comment: 28,800 toys, still drifting. Would you have kept one if you found it?
